# chunk

<link-summary>Splits an array into consecutive groups of a fixed size, validating both arguments.</link-summary>

<web-summary>chunk() — Splits an array into consecutive groups of a fixed size, validating both arguments. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/array</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function chunk<T>(array: T[], size: number = 1): Array<T[]>;
```

`chunk` walks the array once and slices it into groups of `size` elements. When the length does not divide evenly,
the final group holds the remainder and is shorter than the rest. The input array is never modified.

Both arguments are validated before any work happens: a non-array input or a fractional `size` throws instead of
returning a quietly wrong result. A `size` of `0` or less, and an empty input, both produce `[]` rather than a group
of empty groups.

## Parameters

| Parameter                 | Type     | Description                                            |
| :------------------------ | :------- | :----------------------------------------------------- |
| `array`                   | `T[]`    | The array to split. Left untouched.                    |
| `size` _(optional)_ `= 1` | `number` | The length of each group. An integer; defaults to `1`. |

## Returns

`Array<T[]>` — a new array of groups. Every group but the last has exactly `size` elements.

## Throws

| Exception   | Condition                 |
| :---------- | :------------------------ |
| `TypeError` | `array` is not an array.  |
| `TypeError` | `size` is not an integer. |

## Examples

### Splitting into fixed-size groups

```javascript
chunk(["a", "b", "c", "d"], 2); // => [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]]
chunk(["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"], 2); // => [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"], ["e"]]
```

### Writing a large range in batches

A single `setValues` call with tens of thousands of rows is the usual cause of an exceeded execution time. Splitting
the data keeps each call small and each write independently recoverable.

<tabs group="code">
<tab title="TypeScript" group-key="ts">
<code-block lang="typescript" src="chunk.ts" include-symbol="appendRows"/>
</tab>
<tab title="JavaScript" group-key="js">
<code-block lang="javascript">
function appendRows(sheet, rows) {
  for (const batch of chunk(rows, 500)) {
    sheet.getRange(sheet.getLastRow() + 1, 1, batch.length, batch[0].length).setValues(batch);
  }
}
</code-block>
</tab>
</tabs>

### Edge cases

```javascript
chunk([1, 2, 3]); // => [[1], [2], [3]] — size defaults to 1
chunk([], 2); // => []
chunk([1, 2, 3], 0); // => []
chunk("a,b,c", 2); // throws TypeError: Input 'array' must be an array.
chunk([1, 2, 3], 1.5); // throws TypeError: Input 'size' must be an integer.
```
